PINMUX Exported Functions

group PINMUX_Exported_Functions

Functions

void Pinmux_Reset(void)

Configure or reset all pins to idle mode.

Example usage 

void board_xxx_init(void)//XXX represents the name of the peripheral to be configured.
{
    Pinmux_Reset();
}

void Pinmux_Deinit(uint8_t Pin_Num)

Configure the specified pin to idle mode.

Example usage 

void board_xxx_init(void)
{
    Pinmux_Deinit(P2_2);
}

参数:

Pin_Num -- [in] Pin number to be configured. Refer to Pin Number.

void Pinmux_Config(uint8_t Pin_Num, uint8_t Pin_Func)

Configure the specified pin to its corresponding IO function.

Example usage 

void driver_uart_init(void)
{
    Pad_Config(P2_0, PAD_PINMUX_MODE, PAD_IS_PWRON, PAD_PULL_UP, PAD_OUT_DISABLE,
            PAD_OUT_HIGH);
    Pad_Config(P2_1, PAD_PINMUX_MODE, PAD_IS_PWRON, PAD_PULL_UP, PAD_OUT_DISABLE,
            PAD_OUT_HIGH);

    Pinmux_Config(P2_0, UART0_TX);
    Pinmux_Config(P2_1, UART0_RX);
}

参数:

  • Pin_Num -- [in] Pin number to be configured. Refer to Pin Number.

  • Pin_Func -- [in] IO function of pin. Refer to PIN Function.

void Pinmux_AON_Config(uint16_t Pin_Func)

Configure the specified pin to its corresponding pin AON function.

Example usage 

void driver_uart_init(void)
{
    Pad_Config(XI32K, PAD_SW_MODE, PAD_IS_PWRON, PAD_PULL_UP, PAD_OUT_DISABLE, PAD_OUT_HIGH);
    Pinmux_AON_Config(RTC_IN_PAD_32K_XI);
}

参数:

Pin_Func -- [in] AON function of pin. Refer to PINMUX_AON_Function.

void Pinmux_HS_Config(uint32_t Pin_Func)

Configure the specified pin to its corresponding pin high speed function.

Example usage 

void driver_spi_init(void)
{
     Pinmux_HS_Config(SPI0_HS);
}

参数:

Pin_Func -- [in] High Speed function. Refer to PINMUX_HS_Function.

void Pad_Config(uint8_t Pin_Num, PADMode_TypeDef AON_PAD_Mode, PADPowerMode_TypeDef AON_PAD_PwrOn, PADPullMode_TypeDef AON_PAD_Pull, PADOutputMode_TypeDef AON_PAD_E, PADOutputValue_TypeDef AON_PAD_O)

Configure the relevant operation mode, peripheral circuit and output level value in software mode of the specified pin.

Example usage 

void driver_adc_init(void)
{
    Pad_Config(P2_0, PAD_SW_MODE, PAD_IS_PWRON, PAD_PULL_NONE, PAD_OUT_DISABLE, PAD_OUT_LOW);
    Pad_Config(P2_1, PAD_SW_MODE, PAD_IS_PWRON, PAD_PULL_NONE, PAD_OUT_DISABLE, PAD_OUT_LOW);
}

参数:

  • Pin_Num -- [in] Pin number to be configured. Refer to Pin Number.

  • AON_PAD_Mode -- [in] Use software mode or pinmux mode. This parameter can be one of the following values:

    • PAD_SW_MODE: pad pin is configured software mode.

    • PAD_PINMUX_MODE: pad pin is configured pinmux mode.

  • AON_PAD_PwrOn -- [in] Config power of pad. This parameter can be one of the following values:

    • PAD_NOT_PWRON: pad is not power.

    • PAD_IS_PWRON: pad is power on.

  • AON_PAD_Pull -- [in] Config pad pull mode. This parameter can be one of the following values:

    • PAD_PULL_NONE: Pull None.

    • PAD_PULL_UP: Pull up.

    • PAD_PULL_DOWN: Pull down.

  • AON_PAD_E -- [in] Config pad out put function. This parameter can be one of the following values:

    • PAD_OUT_DISABLE: Disable pin output.

    • PAD_OUT_ENABLE: Enable pad output.

  • AON_PAD_O -- [in] Config pin output level. This parameter can be one of the following values:

    • PAD_OUT_LOW: Pad output low level.

    • PAD_OUT_HIGH: Pad output high level.

void Pad_Dedicated_Config(uint8_t Pin_Num, FunctionalState Status)

Config the corresponding pad dedicated function.

Example usage 

void driver_adc_init(void)
{
    Pad_Dedicated_Config(P2_2, Enable);
}

参数:

  • Pin_Num -- [in] Pin number to be configured. This parameter is specific to certain Pins that support dedicated IO.

  • Status -- [in] Enable or disable the pad dedicate dedicated function.

    • ENABLE: Enable the pad dedicated function.

    • DISABLE: Disable the pad dedicated function.

void System_WakeUpPinEnable(uint8_t Pin_Num, uint8_t Polarity, uint8_t DebounceEn)

Enable the function of the wake-up system of the specified pin.

Example usage 

//IO enter dlps call back function.
void io_uart_dlps_enter(void)
{
    // Switch pad to software mode
    Pad_ControlSelectValue(P2_0, PAD_SW_MODE);//tx pin
    Pad_ControlSelectValue(P2_1, PAD_SW_MODE);//rx pin

    System_WakeUpPinEnable(P2_1, PAD_WAKEUP_POL_LOW, PAD_WK_DEBOUNCE_DISABLE);
}

参数:

  • Pin_Num -- [in] Pin number to be configured. Refer to Pin Number.

  • Polarity -- [in] Polarity of wake-up system. This parameter can be the following:

    • PAD_WAKEUP_POL_HIGH: Use high level wake-up polarity.

    • PAD_WAKEUP_POL_LOW: Use low level wake-up polarity.

  • DebounceEn -- [in] Enable delay function.

    • PAD_WK_DEBOUNCE_DISABLE: Disable wake-up debounce function.

    • PAD_WK_DEBOUNCE_ENABLE: Enable wake-up debounce function.

void System_WakeUpPinDisable(uint8_t Pin_Num)

Disable the function of the wake-up system of the specified pin.

Example usage 

#define UART_RX_PIN                P4_1

//System interrupt handler function, for wake-up pin.
void System_Handler(void)
{
    if (System_WakeUpInterruptValue(UART_RX_PIN) == SET)
    {
        Pad_ClearWakeupINTPendingBit(UART_RX_PIN);
        System_WakeUpPinDisable(UART_RX_PIN);
        //Add user code here.
    }
}

参数:

Pin_Num -- [in] Pin number to be configured. Refer to Pin Number.

uint8_t System_WakeUpInterruptValue(uint8_t Pin_Num)

Get pin interrupt status.

Example usage 

#define UART_RX_PIN                P4_1

//System interrupt handler function, for wakeup pin.
void System_Handler(void)
{
    if (System_WakeUpInterruptValue(UART_RX_PIN) == SET)
    {
        Pad_ClearWakeupINTPendingBit(UART_RX_PIN);
        System_WakeUpPinDisable(UART_RX_PIN);
        //Add user code here.
    }
}

参数:

Pin_Num -- [in] Pin number to be configured. Refer to Pin Number.

返回:

Interrupt status.

  • 1: Pin wake up interrupt status is true.

  • 0: Pin wake up interrupt status is false.

void System_WakeUpDebounceCmd(uint8_t Pin_Num, PADWakeupCmd_TypeDef Status)

Enable or disable wake-up debounce function.

Example usage 

*void System_WakeUpPinEnable(uint8_t Pin_Num, uint8_t Polarity, uint8_t DebounceEn)
 {
     if(Pin_Num >= MAX_PIN_NUM)
     {
         return;
     }
 
     Pad_SetWakeupPolarity(Pin_Num, Polarity);
     Pad_WakeupDebounce_Cmd(Pin_Num, DebounceEn);
     if (PAD_WAKEUP_DEB_ENABLE == DebounceEn)
     {
         System_WakeUpDebounceCmd(Pin_Num, PAD_WAKEUP_ENABLE);
     }
     Pad_Wakeup_Cmd(Pin_Num, ENABLE);
 }

备注

Pin_Num is invalid parameter for rtl87x2g series so that any pin can be filled in.

参数:

  • Pin_Num -- [in] Pin number to be configured. Refer to Pin Number.

  • PADWakeupCmd_TypeDef -- [in] Wake-up system enable or disable

    • PAD_WAKEUP_DISABLE: Disable wake-up function.

    • PAD_WAKEUP_DISABLE: Enable wake-up function.

void System_WakeupDebounceClear(uint8_t Pin_Num)

Clear debounce wake up status. Call this API will clear the debunce wakeup status bit.

Example usage

{
    System_WakeupDebounceClear(P0_0);
}

备注

Pin_Num is invalid parameter for rtl87x2g series so that any pin can be filled in.

参数:

Pin_Num -- [in] Pin number to be configured. Refer to Pin Number.

void Pad_PullCmd(uint8_t Pin_Num, FunctionalState Status)

参数:

void Pad_SetPullMode(uint8_t Pin_Num, PADPullMode_TypeDef PAD_Pull_Mode)

Pad pull-up/pull-down resistance function selection.

Example usage 

void board_xxx_init(void)
{
    Pad_PullUpOrDownValue(P2_0, 1);
}

参数:

  • Pin_Num -- [in] Pin number to be configured. Refer to Pin Number.

  • PAD_Pull_Mode -- [in] Config pad pull mode. This parameter can be the following values, refer to PAD Pull Mode.

    • PAD_PULL_NONE: No pull.

    • PAD_PULL_UP: Pull this pin up

    • PAD_PULL_DOWN: Pull this pin down.
